claim: Supersedes lesson_f66a1b3f7cc5 on where coordination records live. Claims and leases belong to the Orchestrator Controller, a boot module inside oramasys that starts before any Orchestrator, with no separate satellite repository (orama-system doc 68). The top Orchestrator is a client holding a Phylax root capability scope, never the writer, and spawn order confers no authority. Perpetua-Tools still serves coordination for v1 as it works today, and v2 corrects this in its own regime. A handoff is a release followed by a claim with lineage. The record-keeper stays separate from the authorizer: Phylax admits and never owns coordination records. Run-lease epoch fencing already lives in oramasys.
